scan.summary: This is a recreational marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to produce marijuana at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, under a Tier II indoor operation with a 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy limit. The license is valid for the current term from March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027, and the holder must renew annually by submitting a renewal application and fee no later than 20 days before expiration.
scan.freshness_note: The license was issued on March 3, 2026, which is current as of today (September 25, 2026). The renewal deadline will be February 10, 2027. This document is current and no newer version is needed at this time.

scan.confidence_notes: I am highly confident in the identity, status, and conditions of this permit. The document is clearly a current recreational marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission on its official letterhead. The significant date (expiration March 2, 2027) is certain. The conditions are explicitly stated in the license document. I have high confidence that condition 2's renewal deadline is February 10, 2027, based on the 20-day advance requirement and March 2, 2027 expiration date. I did not find the specific text of OAR 845-025-1450 (video surveillance standards) in my search, so I cannot verify the exact surveillance requirements referenced in condition 4, though the citation appears correct. I am certain this is a permit (not a new application), and it has no gaps as permits are agency documents; what matters is meeting the stated conditions and renewing before the deadline.
